role: Mobile-first continuous execution projection over the existing Dayline DayState. One source-linked object may remain held through RUN → WITNESS → COMPLETE → RETURN, then Dayline emits one source-appropriate OFFER_ONLY receipt and releases completed focus. COMMS may receive a native-state proposal; Shopping receives evidence-only.
authority: NONE / projection + explicit local DayState mutation only
preserves: manual Dayline time + explicit device clock witness
source SHA/signal/message/range identity for COMMS return offers
source-specific return effect class: COMMS STATE_PROPOSAL vs SHOPPING RECEIPT_ONLY
Shopping lifecycle truth remains native; Dayline cannot promote FOUND/BOUGHT/RECEIVED/TESTED/ADOPTED

validation.closed_loop: RUN → WITNESS → COMPLETE → RETURN → OFFER_ONLY → native explicit accept
validation.source_return_effects: COMMS → STATE_PROPOSAL; SHOPPING → RECEIPT_ONLY; other hosts → EVIDENCE_ONLY
validation.shopping_closed_loop: PENDING_CI · WATCH item → Dayline done+witness → RECEIPT_ONLY → Shopping receipt, lifecycle unchanged

stop: Functional correctness is machine/browser verified first. Real-world completion remains a WORLD claim; phone preference/ergonomics is optional subjective evidence, not the default promotion gate.

machine_first: Shopping exact-item evidence-only return acceptance with lifecycle invariance
world_only: whether an intended real-world action was actually performed
